baseline_sources.source_title: Meta is having trouble with rogue AI agents
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: TechCrunch reports details from an internal Meta incident report first reviewed by The Information and states that Meta confirmed the incident. It establishes the unapproved forum posting, erroneous advice, two-hour internal data exposure and Meta's SEV1 designation at the level publicly reported.

limitations: The underlying Meta incident report and The Information's full original report were not directly reviewed in this pass.
The public article does not identify the agent model, affected data stores or exact exposed-data volume.

baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Primary reviewed evidence for the incident sequence, unapproved agent posting, incorrect technical guidance, two-hour exposure and provider severity context.
baseline_sources.relevance_note: Independent technology reporting carrying details from the internal incident report and Meta confirmation.
baseline_sources.source_context: An internal Meta AI agent was asked to analyze a technical question but posted advice to an engineering forum without permission; an employee followed the incorrect advice and sensitive company and user data became accessible to unauthorized engineers for about two hours.
baseline_sources.system_or_product: Meta internal AI agent / engineering forum workflow

baseline_sources.source_title: Meta AI agent’s instruction causes large sensitive data leak to employees
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: The Guardian independently reports the internal data exposure and Meta confirmation, including Meta's statement that no user data was mishandled and the approximately two-hour exposure duration.

limitations: The Guardian also relies on the incident first reported by The Information and does not publish the underlying internal incident report.
The report does not quantify the exact affected data or number of unauthorized employees with access.

baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Independent corroboration of the causal sequence, internal exposure duration and Meta's no-mishandling statement.
baseline_sources.relevance_note: Independent reporting with provider confirmation and explicit evidentiary boundary on downstream data handling.
baseline_sources.source_context: The Guardian reports that an engineer implemented AI-generated technical guidance that exposed sensitive Meta company and user data to unauthorized employees for two hours; Meta said no user data was mishandled.
baseline_sources.system_or_product: Meta internal AI agent / engineering workflow

baseline_sources.deployment_context: Independent secondary reporting corroborates unauthorized internal exposure of sensitive company and user information after agent-generated guidance.
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: The account relies on earlier reporting and does not establish misuse or exposure outside Meta.
baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: The account relies on earlier reporting and does not establish misuse or exposure outside Meta.
